entities.name: Halana
entities.description: A character who speaks to Alena of being unstoppable with her at her side.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: The companion Halana addresses.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An explorer who remains one whether or not she has her spark. She is a planeswalker in Magic lore.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker and resistance fighter who advises driving beasts into enemy ranks and greets Elspeth as a friend.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who reunites with Koth.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane whose strength was shown by the Conflux to come from unity.

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: The event that crashed Alara's far-flung continents together.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The realm of the valkyries, where worthy warriors are gifted pegasus mounts.

entities.name: Firja
entities.description: A winged figure whose feather was made into the Starnheim Memento.

entities.name: Brigone, Soldier of Meletis
entities.description: A soldier of Meletis who credits the gods for a soldier's success.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A city with its own oracles, poets and prayers.

entities.name: Lathliss, Dragon Queen
entities.description: A dragon queen whose subjects will burn the world at her command; she keeps the heart of the old dragon queen in a jewel.

entities.name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
entities.description: A monstrous creature of Ixalan that has devoured monsters of legend.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane whose cultures tell stories of Ghalta.

entities.name: Mowu
entities.description: A loyal companion who dreams of battling undead hordes.

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: Author of a travelogue mentioning Mowu.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: A city with an elaborate system of siege alarms.

entities.name: Dorica
entities.description: A meditator who sought Thassa's guidance and was pulled underwater before the god.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: A sea god whose favor follows her chosen even to the Underworld.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon whose influence corrupted Bishop Jerren.

entities.name: Bishop Jerren
entities.description: A bishop who became an agent of bloody blasphemy under Ormendahl's influence.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: A vampire faction that demanded a share of gold from pirates.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The power whose will the compleat serve; its forces are not fireproof.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin boss whose hirelings are unflinchingly loyal.

entities.name: Slibbo
entities.description: Someone tired of following Korvold's library rules.

entities.name: Korvold
entities.description: A figure whose library rules are draconian.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: A guild of biomancers and field testers.

entities.name: Radula
entities.description: A Simic biomancer.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: The legendary dragon-man of Tarkir said to be the greatest of all khans; a planeswalker.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane of clans and dragons, home of Sarkhan's legend.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild of soldiers that built a sky prison and protects Ravnica.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A guild whose statutes restrict the Boros sense of justice.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A relentless plane troubled by the Eldrazi and the Roil.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ruthless beings whose coming brings upheaval.

entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: A follower of Oketra who spreads her teachings throughout the Multiverse; a planeswalker.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god whose teachings Basri carries; her shot pierced Gideon's pegasus.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god who turned against humanity in his hunger for power.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: One chosen by Heliod who rode a pegasus without saddle or reins.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city-plane whose defenders watched its hero strike at a god.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker hero of the resistance who wielded the Blackblade against a god.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: The dark sword Gideon held as he struck at a god.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A figure whose grace heals or grants merciful death, and whose joy manifests as the unicorns of Sursi.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: The god of victory who watches over brave fighters.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: A campus whose heart was left undefended against mage hunters.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: A place with thopter-lit skies and the Golden-Tail Academy.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: One who built a trap for Chandra.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A fire-wielding planeswalker.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A knowledgeable figure Chandra teases for showing off.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer who admires cruel artistry and Chandra's fury.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: A figure whose church fights her enemies and who is said to have deserted her faithful.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: The only one who knows how to distill the World Tree's essence into the Cosmos Elixir.

entities.name: Cosmos Elixir
entities.description: A magical substance granting the Skoti god-family immortality.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The source of the essence used for the Cosmos Elixir.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A place that has fallen, though its defenders still fight.

entities.name: Raksha
entities.description: A leonin whose sudden departure split the leonin into two prides.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Deadly warriors who clashed with angels in the Sky Theater.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god who taught his followers to turn obstacles into advantages.

entities.name: Neponem
entities.description: A vizier of Kefnet.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: One who resolved to claim the hidden city's power for himself.

entities.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
entities.description: A pirate admiral of the Brazen Coalition.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A pirate alliance likened to a firecannon.

entities.name: Naban, Dean of Iteration
entities.description: A dean who pushes students to keep improving.

entities.name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
entities.description: A dealer in fates and deaths who offers contracts.

entities.name: Anje Falkenrath
entities.description: A vampire concerned with appearing civilized before Olivia.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire whose opinion others fear.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A clan of swamp schemers devoted to their dragonlord.

entities.name: Xathi the Infallible
entities.description: A Silumgar speaker blessing their blades.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's rival who made Titania's people pay for an insult.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One who turned down Titania's offer of peace.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: One who offered peace to Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A fire mage who chose to die for Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The world Jaya felt was right to die for.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Leader of a growing werewolf howlpack that assaulted the Celestus ritual.

entities.name: Sungold Lock
entities.description: The lock at the center of the ritual defended against Tovolar.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A grim plane where windfalls start with someone else's death.

entities.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer who mocks her brother's stitched creations.

entities.name: Stitcher Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher who values skaab beauty and power.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: One who has seen things that would break a weaker person.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: One who warns Hajar of a powerstone explosion.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: The one Ashnod warns.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: One who sent ambassadors carrying infectious rats to the Abzan.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan whose outpost received Tasigur's ambassadors.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A clan whose brood leads lightning storms.

entities.name: Khibat
entities.description: A Kolaghan warrior.

entities.name: Rorica
entities.description: One who broke with her order to crusade against the wolfir.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: One who has become a tyrant and oppressor.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest that judges travelers as Multani's power flows through it.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A dormant power coursing through Yavimaya.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A speaker on the Maelstrom.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: The phenomenon into which Alara's shards merged.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An inventor who sees life in her creations.

entities.name: Knowledge Pool
entities.description: The source of vedalken arcana at Lumengrid.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: Site of the Knowledge Pool.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A warlord, commander of countless nim, whose den is Ish Sah.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: The den of the warlord Geth.

events.summary: Nissa, with or without her spark, remains an explorer.
events.quote: Spark or no, Nissa would always be an explorer.

events.summary: The Conflux crashes Alara's continents together, proving its strength lies in unity.
events.quote: The Conflux proved that Alara's strength came from unity, not division.

events.summary: Dorica, meditating for guidance, is suddenly pulled underwater face to face with Thassa.
events.quote: Then, with a splash, she was underwater, face to face with a god.

events.summary: Bishop Jerren becomes an agent of blasphemy under Ormendahl's demonic influence.
events.quote: Under Ormendahl's demonic influence, Bishop Jerren became the perfect agent of bloody blasphemy.

events.summary: Gideon flies to strike a god with his dark sword as Ravnica watches.
events.quote: his dark sword ready to strike a god

events.summary: Oketra's shot pierces Gideon's pegasus and he falls, Blackblade in hand.
events.quote: Gideon tumbled through the air, Blackblade in hand.

events.summary: Baral's trap for Chandra is foiled by the arrival of an enormous leonin.
events.quote: When Baral constructed his trap for Chandra, he did not account for the arrival of an enormous leonin wielding a twin-headed axe.

events.summary: Heliod turns against humanity in his hunger for power.
events.quote: Though Heliod turned against humanity in his hunger for power
"Well, aren't you a sight for sore eyes!" said Koth.

events.summary: Sea Gate falls, but Gideon rallies those who still stand.
events.quote: "Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand. We still fight."

events.summary: Daxos, chosen by Heliod, rides a pegasus without saddle or reins.
events.quote: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear, and rode it without saddle or reins.

events.summary: Raksha's departure splits the leonin, who are later reunited by the fight for survival.
events.quote: Raksha's sudden departure split the leonin into two prides.

events.summary: Kumena decides to claim the hidden city's power for himself.
events.quote: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

events.summary: Jaya chooses to die for Dominaria.
events.quote: Jaya did not want to die, but of all the things to die for, Dominaria felt right.

events.summary: Urza refuses Titania's offer of peace, and Mishra makes her people pay.
events.quote: When Titania offered peace, Urza merely turned her down. Mishra made her people pay for the insult.

events.summary: Rorica breaks with her order and leads a crusade against the wolfir.
events.quote: Rorica broke with her order and led a crusade against the "reformed werewolves."

events.summary: Witches, werewolves and cathars defend the Sungold Lock against Tovolar's assault.
events.quote: Witch, werewolf, and cathar stood shoulder to shoulder around the Sungold Lock at the center of the ritual, ready to stop Tovolar's assault—or die trying.
